name: claude-code-app
description: Looks and works like the Claude Code desktop app: a warm near-black page, the clay accent, sessions filterable by status, project or environment and grouped by project, tool rows with the file in a chip and its line counts, the branch bar over a dark rounded composer.

files.themes/claude-code-app.json:
// The Claude Code desktop app: a warm near-black page, a slightly darker sidebar, the clay accent,
// no borders.
{
  "name": "Claude Code app",
  "description": "A warm near-black page, a darker sidebar, the clay accent, no borders.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  "colors": { "background": "#1f1e1c", "foreground": "#ececea", "selection": "#3a3936", "accent": "#d97757" },
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#181816",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#1f1e1c",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "dot",

  "appearance.density": "comfortable"
}
